author: GameSpot
description:
Cairn, a climbing and survival game from The Game Bakers is an experience filled to the brim with small and big choices, whether the player knows they're making them or not. 

Where will Aava place her hands and feet when climbing a wall? Which route up a wall will you make her take? When she comes across abandoned camps along the climb, will you prioritize scavenging climbing gear or raw materials to be cooked into a hearty meal down the line?

#cairn #gamereview  #gaming
title: Cairn Review - An Uphill Battle Worth Taking On
